title: An Algebra of Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2610.36795v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On the theoretic analyses on transforms, they mainly focus on the computability analysis, such the Turing-completeness of unbounded precision transformers, the advantage of parallelizability of unbounded precision transformers and the limitations of bounded precision transformers. This paper give transformers an algebra for reasoning, which relies heavily on the functional decomposition results of transformers. This algebra uses functional decompositions as atomic actions, includes sequential composition and parallel composition, recursion for feedback and abstraction for hidden layers. As we know, it is the first attempt to model transformers logically and can be used to verify the correctness of transformer based applications.

translated_abstract: 目前针对Transformer的理论分析主要集中在可计算性方面，例如无界精度Transformer的图灵完备性、无界精度Transformer的并行化优势，以及有界精度Transformer的局限性。本文为Transformer提供了一种用于推理的代数系统，该代数在很大程度上依赖于Transformer的函数分解结果。该代数以函数分解作为原子操作，包含顺序组合与并行组合、用于反馈的递归，以及用于隐藏内部层的抽象。据我们所知，这是首次以逻辑方式对Transformer进行建模的尝试，可用于验证基于Transformer的应用程序的正确性。
tldr: 本文首次提出了一种基于函数分解结果的Transformer代数系统，通过顺序组合、并行组合、递归和抽象等操作实现对Transformer的逻辑建模，并可用于验证基于Transformer的应用的正确性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the first algebra for reasoning about Transformers, built on functional decomposition results with sequential and parallel composition, recursion, and abstraction, enabling logical modeling and correctness verification of Transformer-based applications.
